name: Summer at Foote (The Foote School Summer Programs)
description_short: Summer programs on the campus of The Foote School, an independent K-9 school in New Haven. There are two programs: FooteSteps to Broadway, a two-week musical theater program that ends in a cabaret performance, and Falco's Explorers, where campers sign up each week for classes such as music, Dungeons & Dragons, crafts, LEGO STEM and fencing.
